title: Prefill Coordinator + Kernel Advisor and Replay-Invariant Audit
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Reduce prefill-induced capture instability and ensure deterministic replay correctness across heterogeneous streams by introducing a Prefill Coordinator, a Kernel Advisor scoring layer, and an automated Replay-Invariant Audit (RIA) harness.
Background: We see intermittent cudaGraph recapture failures and non-deterministic divergences when multi-stream decodes interleave prefill and decode kernels (esp. mixed attention implementations and quantized kernels). Root causes identified in triage: (1) inconsistent kernel selection during capture vs replay when occupancy or tensor layouts differ, (2) racey prefill boundary conditions that create ephemeral schedule differences, (3) absence of deterministic seeding for kernel heuristics and fusion decisions.
Proposed work:
- Prefill Coordinator: a lightweight scheduler that enforces prefill quiesce windows, records boundary epochs, and emits a compact prefill manifest used during capture/replay to align KV cache epochs.
- Kernel Advisor: scoring function that chooses kernel variants deterministically based on a canonicalized workload fingerprint (sequence length distribution, batch shape, quant type, attention mode) rather than runtime occupancy alone. Scores stored with capture metadata to force replay-consistent kernel selection.
- Replay-Invariant Audit (RIA): an automated test harness that performs shadow replays of captured graphs across permutations (varying stream interleaving, prefill timings, and kernel affinities) and checks bitwise/equivalence invariants, KV consistency, and latency regressions.
Success criteria: (a) reduce cudaGraph recapture/replay-failure rate in our nightly fuzz suite from ~3.4% to <0.3%, (b) eliminate class of non-deterministic divergence bugs observed in recent CI flakiness (examples attached), (c) no >2% P99 latency regression on canonical serving traces, (d) provide telemetry to explain any remaining fallbacks.
Deliverables: design doc, kernel-advisor library, prefill coordinator logic in serving runtime, RIA harness and CI job, migration guide for models.
Rollout plan: behind a runtime flag: "prefill_coordinator_v1" and "kernel_advisor_locked"; staged canary on dedicated pools, shadow rollouts in hosted with synthetic traces, then full enablement if metrics pass for 2 weeks.
Telemetry & metrics: per-capture metadata emission (fingerprint + kernel_score), capture->replay checksum diffs, recapture/fallback counts, per-model P50/P95/P99 delta.
Risk & mitigations:
- Risk: Advisor forces suboptimal kernel selection harming throughput. Mitigation: advisor includes a score rollback policy and runtime A/B to allow alternate kernel when throughput falls >5% while maintaining correctness.
- Risk: RIA increases CI runtime. Mitigation: RIA runs as a separate nightly job with prioritized permutations and a fast smoke check in presubmit.
Dependencies: kernel telemetry schema change (INF-8942), CI infra support for shadow replays (ENG-702345), model catalog tags for quant type.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Nightly fuzz job shows recurrence <0.3% replay failure for graph captures; 2) RIA harness detects and reports any checksum deviations and links to reproducible traces; 3) No P99 latency regression >2% on canonical traces for enabled models; 4) Capture metadata schema change merged and consumed by runtime; 5) Migration guide and runtime flags documented in Confluence.
implementation_notes:
- Use a canonical fingerprint: sha1(sequence-lengths + batch-shapes + quant-mode + attention-mode + op-layout-hash).
- KernelAdvisor returns stable integer score + preferred kernel id; advisor stores fallback list ordered by score.
- Prefill Coordinator inserts ephemeral epoch markers into capture metadata and exposes a 'quiesce' API for multi-stream callers.
- Add deterministic RNG seeding for heuristics and fusion pass (seed derived from capture fingerprint).
- Maintain backward compatibility: if captured graph lacks advisor metadata, fall back to current heuristic with extra audit logging.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for kernel advisor scoring with permutations of inputs.
- RIA permutations: (a) single-threaded capture vs multi-stream interleaving, (b) prefill at boundary offsets [-2,+2] tokens, (c) mixed quant kernels and fused attention toggles.
- Binary equivalence tests (where possible) and functional output-equivalence via normalized logits/ids.
- Performance baseline runs on representative models (Llama-3-13B, MPT-7B) to assert throughput/latency impact.
- Add CI presubmit smoke that does one shadow-replay per PR affecting advisor or coordinator code.
risks:
- Potential throughput regression if Advisor locks suboptimal kernels; mitigated by A/B and rollback policy.
- Increased capture metadata size; mitigate by compact encoding.
- Edge cases with custom fused-attention kernels from third-party vendors; will require vendor tests & fallbacks.
